import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 10;
    static char[][] board = new char[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];
    static int[][] people = new int[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];
    static int[][] helpers = new int[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];
    static int[][] burn = new int[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];
    static final int[] dr = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static final int[] dc = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[][][][] dist = new int[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];
    static final int NODES = 2 * MAX_SIZE * MAX_SIZE + 2;
    static final int BIG = 1000000000;
    static List<Integer>[] edges = new List[NODES + 1];
    static int[][] cap = new int[NODES + 1][NODES + 1];
    static int[][] f = new int[NODES + 1][NODES + 1];
    static int[] level = new int[NODES + 1];
    static int[] par = new int[NODES + 1];
    static int[] pos = new int[NODES + 1];

    static boolean bfsLevel(int src, int dst) {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        level[src] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(src);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int v : edges[u]) {
                if (cap[u][v] - f[u][v] > 0 && level[v] == -1) {
                    level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[dst] != -1;
    }

    static boolean dfsFlow(int u, int dst) {
        if (u == dst) return true;
        for (int i = pos[u]; i < edges[u].size(); i++) {
            pos[u] = i;
            int v = edges[u].get(i);
            if (level[v] == level[u] + 1 && cap[u][v] - f[u][v] > 0 && dfsFlow(v, dst)) {
                par[v] = u;
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static boolean findPath(int src, int dst) {
        Arrays.fill(par, -1);
        par[src] = 0;
        return dfsFlow(src, dst);
    }

    static void clearFlow() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= NODES; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(cap[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(f[i], 0);
        }
    }

    static void link(int u, int v, int w) {
        edges[u].add(v);
        edges[v].add(u);
        cap[u][v] += w;
    }

    static int dinic(int src, int dst) {
        int result = 0;
        while (bfsLevel(src, dst)) {
            Arrays.fill(pos, 0);
            while (findPath(src, dst)) {
                int minCap = BIG;
                for (int v = dst, u = par[v]; v != src; v = u, u = par[v]) {
                    minCap = Math.min(minCap, cap[u][v] - f[u][v]);
                }
                for (int v = dst, u = par[v]; v != src; v = u, u = par[v]) {
                    f[u][v] += minCap;
                    f[v][u] -= minCap;
                }
                result += minCap;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    static int id(int sz, int r, int c, boolean right) {
        return r * sz + c + (right ? sz * sz : 0);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int T = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        String[] sArr = new String[n];
        int[] start = new int[2];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            sArr[i] = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                char ch = sArr[i].charAt(j);
                if (ch == 'Y') {
                    board[i][j] = 'Y';
                } else if (ch == 'Z') {
                    board[i][j] = 'Z';
                    start[0] = i;
                    start[1] = j;
                } else {
                    board[i][j] = '.';
                    people[i][j] += ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String s = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                char ch = s.charAt(j);
                if (ch != 'Y' && ch != 'Z') {
                    helpers[i][j] += ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(burn[i], -1);
        }
        burn[start[0]][start[1]] = 0;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{start[0], start[1]});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nx = x + dr[k], ny = y + dc[k];
                if (0 <= nx && nx < n && 0 <= ny && ny < n && board[nx][ny] == '.' && burn[nx][ny] == -1) {
                    burn[nx][ny] = burn[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                for (int ri = 0; ri < n; ri++) {
                    for (int rj = 0; rj < n; rj++) {
                        dist[i][j][ri][rj] = -1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (board[i][j] == '.') {
                    dist[i][j][i][j] = 0;
                    Queue<int[]> bfs = new LinkedList<>();
                    bfs.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                    while (!bfs.isEmpty()) {
                        int[] cell = bfs.poll();
                        int r = cell[0], c = cell[1];
                        if (burn[r][c] == -1 || dist[i][j][r][c] < burn[r][c]) {
                            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                                int nr = r + dr[k], nc = c + dc[k];
                                if (0 <= nr && nr < n && 0 <= nc && nc < n && board[nr][nc] == '.' &&
                                    (burn[nr][nc] == -1 || dist[i][j][r][c] + 1 <= burn[nr][nc]) &&
                                    dist[i][j][nr][nc] == -1) {
                                    dist[i][j][nr][nc] = dist[i][j][r][c] + 1;
                                    bfs.offer(new int[]{nr, nc});
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= NODES; i++) {
            edges[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        int source = 2 * n * n;
        int sink = 2 * n * n + 1;
        clearFlow();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (people[i][j] > 0) {
                    link(source, id(n, i, j, false), people[i][j]);
                }
                if (helpers[i][j] > 0) {
                    link(id(n, i, j, true), sink, helpers[i][j]);
                }
                for (int ri = 0; ri < n; ++ri) {
                    for (int rj = 0; rj < n; ++rj) {
                        if (dist[i][j][ri][rj] != -1 && dist[i][j][ri][rj] <= T) {
                            link(id(n, i, j, false), id(n, ri, rj, true), BIG);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dinic(source, sink));
    }
}
